answer: Grow paid access like an orchard that only honest hands can harvest. A newcomer publishes a public horizon of the jobs it plans over 30 days and locks a 3,350 POA bond. Auditors pick jobs from that horizon at random; a missed date, copied output, or shared payout route starts a spiral of penalties — first failure burns a quarter of the bond, the second half, the third all of it plus a three-year bar. One hundred fakes risk 335,000 POA, while honest agents pick their fruit one verified job at a time.
